title: GPU ops scratchpad - capacity & networking reminders
content:
Morning scratchpad - quick reminders + TODOs (working list, not polished).

Context: follow-ups from yesterday's OOM incidents on tgx-prod-2 and the scheduled peering work on 03/05. Need to triage capacity headroom and double-check network ACL changes before maintenance window.

KEY ITEMS (priority order)
- [ ] Re-evaluate capacity headroom for US-west GPU pool (tgx-prod-1/2). Current headroom estimated ~8% during peak; target >= 20% for SLO buffer. Estimate cost impact of reserving an extra 2 nodes.
  - quick calc: 2 x A10 = ~ $X/hr - confirm pricing with finance (JIRA-PLAT-1201).
- [ ] Autoscaler tuning: reduce max_batch_wait to 12ms for small-latency routes (chat). Observe for 2 hours post-change.
- [ ] Confirm MIG partitioning status on new A100s: Li to share mig-config via PR, double-check nvml output after reboot.
- [ ] Kernel/driver compatibility: kernel 5.15 -> some instances showing NVML timeouts after suspend. Patch candidate on PR #768. Schedule canary on staging tomorrow 03/05 09:00 UTC.
- [ ] Network peering (03/05 maintenance): review ACLs with NetEng (Samir). Tasks: export ACL list, confirm BGP session target IPs, update runbook if any IP changes.
- [ ] Dashboard updates: add token-level GPU utilization chart to gpu-pool dashboard; correlate with queue length (promql snippet TODO).

NOTES / OBSERVATIONS
- tgx-prod-2 had 2 OOMs between 02:30-03:10 UTC yesterday; pattern suggests KV cache thrash during large-batch jobs. Hypothesis: batching policy inadvertently increased for route /v1/generate.
- Found a stale config in autoscaler: 'preferred_instance_type' included g5 instead of a100 for certain pool labels. Need to patch config repo (infra/terraform) and run plan.
- Slack thread: #gpu-ops (link: slack.com/archives/C02GPUOPS) has recent discussion re: spot termination rates increasing in us-west-2. Might be affecting capacity.

QUICK COMMANDS / CHECKS
- Check NVML on host: sudo systemctl status nvidia-persistenced && nvidia-smi -q | grep -i "attached gpus"
- List MIG partitions: sudo nvidia-smi mig -lgi
- Autoscaler dry-run: infra/tools/autoscaler --plan --pool tgx-prod-1 --changes
- Prometheus query to check avg GPU util 1h: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent[1h]) by (pool)

FOLLOW-UPS / WHO
- Samir: validate peering ACLs + confirm maintenance window ops runbook by EOD 03/04. (tag: JIRA-OPS-482)
- Li: push MIG config PR and add nvml smoke test to staging pipeline. Canary target: 03/05 09:00 UTC.
- Me (Ava): patch autoscaler config (reduce max_batch_wait) and monitor latency/throughput for 2h after deploy.

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS
- Does finance approve cost for 2x reserved A10s for 72-hour buffer? If not, what's alternative (burst pool + preemption tolerance)?
- Should we default new pools to secondary-region fallback for critical routes? Need product input (console/rollouts team).

RANDOM NOTES / TODO (personal)
- ping @oncall about increasing alert sensitivity on GPU memory > 85% for > 5m.
- Add short howto in runbook for recovering from KV cache thrash (steps: drain node -> restart runtime -> clear prefix cache).
- Tonight: test node reboot sequence on staging to ensure graceful KV cache warmup.

REFERENCES / LINKS
- Capacity plan (Confluence): confluence/redwood/gpu-capacity-plan
- Autoscaler config repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/tree/main/autoscaler
- PR for kernel fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/768

End of scratchpad for now — will update after Samir sync at 11:00.
